lineage.summary: Parallel 8-bit Gigabit Media Independent Interface (the wide bus SGMII serializes).
Cisco Serial-GMII; serialized GMII over 1.25 GBd.
Clarified Config_Reg speed/duplex/link encoding and optional 625 MHz DDR clock.

backward_compat_traps.rule: SGMII is the MAC<->PHY SerDes link, not the Ethernet MAC frame layer; it defines no preamble/SFD, no 48-bit MAC address, and no Ethernet CRC-32 framing.
backward_compat_traps.trap: Decoding SGMII as an Ethernet MAC frame (looking for preamble/addresses/FCS) is wrong.

backward_compat_traps.rule: SGMII serializes GMII onto ONE 1.25 GBd differential pair with 8B/10B; RGMII is a PARALLEL two 4-bit DDR bus at 125 MHz.
backward_compat_traps.trap: Treating SGMII as a parallel reduced-pin GMII (RGMII) misses the SerDes 8B/10B serialization.

backward_compat_traps.rule: SGMII reuses the 1000BASE-X Clause-37 AN machine but REDEFINES the 16-bit Config_Reg to carry speed (11:10)/duplex(12)/link(15) instead of 1000BASE-X ability bits.
backward_compat_traps.trap: Interpreting the SGMII Config_Reg as 1000BASE-X duplex/pause ability fields is wrong.
